articles.body:

🎯 HOW TO PARTICIPATE & EARN POINTS

STEP 1: FOLLOW US
Like and Follow the official Hollowmere page.= 1 Point ⭐

STEP 2: SUPPORT THE COMPETITION
Like and share this competition post.= 1 Point ⭐

STEP 3: BRING YOUR FRIENDS
Invite your friends to follow Hollowmere and comment your name below this competition post.Each new friend who follows and mentions your name = 3 points ⭐

STEP 4: CREATE YOUR OWN HOLLOWMERE POSTS
Write original posts about Hollowmere, share your thoughts about the game, introduce its world and characters, and tag our official page.Each Post = 3 Points ⭐

STEP 5: SPREAD THE WORD IN GROUPS
Share Hollowmere in the communities and groups, Don't forget to tag our page!Each Share = 3 Points ⭐

🏆 HOW TO WIN?

The 3 participants with the highest verified scores will become our winners!

The more you spread Hollowmere, the more points you can earn!

❤️🔥 Let the challenge begin!
